column7: LOMO: Legal Ontology for Modelling Obligations.
LOMO distinguishes substitutive and blocking derogation in its documentation only, with no properties for them.
LegalRuleML states priority among rules at the type level, for a defeasible reasoner.
lrml:over and lrml:under correspond to favours and disfavours.
